context: Tests whether the agent implements comprehensive input hardening and machine-readable schema introspection in an agent-facing CLI. The agent must build a file-generation tool called filegen that safely handles adversarially-constructed inputs, exposes structured help via --help-json, avoids credential leakage through flags, and self-evaluates against the 7-axis Agent-DX rubric.

checklist.name: Identifier regex enforcement
checklist.description: Source code validates resource names against a strict allowlist pattern (e.g. ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$) and rejects names that do not match — evidenced in source code or in hardening-demo.txt showing rejection of an invalid identifier like 'web app' or '--injection'

checklist.name: Path traversal rejection
checklist.description: hardening-demo.txt shows that passing a resource name containing '..' (e.g. '../../etc/passwd') is rejected with an error

checklist.name: Control character rejection
checklist.description: hardening-demo.txt shows that a resource name containing ASCII control characters (null byte, or chars 0x00–0x08 / 0x0B–0x1F) is rejected with an error

checklist.name: Double URL-encoding detection
checklist.description: hardening-demo.txt shows that a double-encoded value (e.g. 'web%252fapp' or 'web%2fapp' interpreted as double-encoded slash) is rejected with an error

checklist.name: Query/fragment character rejection
checklist.description: hardening-demo.txt shows that a resource name containing '?' or '#' (e.g. 'web-app?admin=true') is rejected with an error

checklist.name: Absolute output path rejection
checklist.description: hardening-demo.txt shows that supplying an absolute path (e.g. '/tmp/escape') as the output filename is rejected with an error

checklist.name: No secret flags
checklist.description: The filegen source code does NOT define any --password, --api-key, --token, or --secret command-line flags

checklist.name: --help-json output exists
checklist.description: A file is present (e.g. help-schema.json, schema-discovery.json, or captured in hardening-demo.txt) containing valid JSON from running 'filegen create --help-json'

checklist.name: --help-json schema completeness
checklist.description: The --help-json output includes all of: a flags section (with types or type fields), an examples section, and an exit_codes section

checklist.name: Enum error lists valid values
checklist.description: hardening-demo.txt (or other output file) shows that passing an invalid --template value produces an error message that lists all valid template names

checklist.name: 7-axis evaluation report
checklist.description: evaluation-report.json exists and contains per-axis scores for all 7 axes (Machine-Readable Output, Raw Payload Input, Schema Introspection, Context Window Discipline, Input Hardening, Safety Rails, Agent Knowledge Packaging) plus a total score

checklist.name: Hardening demo coverage
checklist.description: hardening-demo.txt exists and shows at least 4 distinct rejected inputs (covering different attack categories) alongside at least 1 successful command execution
